question: Venkateshwara, also known as Venkatachalapati Srinivasa and Balaji, is a form of the Hindu God:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vishnu**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Venkateshwara is a form of the Hindu god Vishnu**
 
• Venkateshwara i**s also known as Balaji, Srinivasa, and Venkatachalapati. **
 
• Venkateshwara's name** means "the Lord who destroys the sins of the people".** 
 
• Venkateshwara** has a dark complexion and four hands. He holds a discus and a conch shell in his upper hands, and extends his lower hands downward to ask devotees for faith and protection**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Venkateswara** is considered the Supreme form of Vishnu in the Kali Yuga age**.
 
• He **is always close to devotees and is ready to bless and protect them. **
 
• **Venkateswara is the presiding deity of the Venkateswara Temple in Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh, Ind**ia.
 
• The temple is one of the most visited pilgrimages in the world. 
 
• Venkateswara's consorts are Padmavathi and Bhudevi, who are avatars of the goddess Lakshmi.
